final_resume.summary: Software Engineer II with 3 years of full-stack development experience building distributed systems and large-scale services using Java, JavaScript, and modern cloud technologies. Proven ability to design robust backend architectures, lead code reviews, and collaborate across teams to deliver production-grade systems. Seeking to contribute to Google Cloud's mission through system design expertise and commitment to code quality.

bullets: Built Spring Boot microservices for shipment tracking that process 2 million events daily from Kafka, demonstrating expertise in distributed systems and large-scale data handling.
Developed React and TypeScript UI components for the dispatcher console serving 300 operators, ensuring responsive design and seamless user experience.
Implemented contract tests between tracking API and console frontend, preventing 9 breaking changes from reaching production and improving code review quality.
Executed JMeter load tests for high-traffic festive-sale release, validating system performance under 5x peak load.

projects.name: A11y Audit Helper
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript browser extension that automatically flags accessibility issues such as missing alt text and low-contrast elements, improving web compliance scanning efficiency.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Pub/Sub to directly align with Google's infrastructure.
Deepen Python expertise by building a backend service or data processing pipeline; Python is a core language for Google and appears frequently in system design interviews.
Lead a formal design review or architecture discussion at your current role and document it; this directly demonstrates the 'lead design reviews' responsibility.
final_resume.growth_note: Strong match on distributed systems and code quality fundamentals. Primary gap: no explicit GCP or Python experience. AWS/Kubernetes background transfers well; recommend upskilling in GCP and Python before applying.
